statement: Under the standard no-side-information Landauer reset model and unchanged d-dimensional quantum records, I(X:Y) <= min(log2 d, Q_reset/(k_B T ln 2)).
assumptions: no retained useful side information during reset

audits.dimensions_csv: d=1..12 with k=d+3 at T=300 K
